text: i didnt even see the all parts toggle because its in a horrible location
resolution: The user couldn't size a whole multi-layer model without merging every layer into one part — and the merge is exactly what turned the shelf into a single-AABB prop (req_1687). Root cause: the group-transform capability ALREADY existed (the all-parts gizmo, req_1287, which move/resize/rotates every layer together about the model's shared center and correctly supports uniform + per-axis scale), but its toggle was a dim monospace chip buried at the far end of a wrapping toolbar row, and it disappeared entirely once a model was down to 1 part — so the user said 'i didnt even see the all parts toggle because its in a horrible location.' Fix is pure discoverability, no behavior change: relocated the toggle to sit immediately next to the object-mode tab (the most prominent control in the editor), relabeled it self-describingly ('▢ size all N layers' → '▣ all N layers') with a clear tooltip stating you never need to merge to resize the whole thing, and persisted it as twig state (studio:allParts) so the choice sticks across hot reloads instead of resetting each session. Still OFF by default and still gated to object mode with 2+ layers. Verified the hmsc-int cart bundles clean (tools/tsc-check). UI relocation only; live-verify via tools/rjit dev hmsc-int (Studio editor can't be headless-shot here). Commit e18a010d1.
